subject: Compliance-conditioned pilot credit request & attestation for Enclave POC
messages:
From: Sam Farrell <sam.farrell@enclavehealth.io>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com
Cc: devops@enclavehealth.io, procurement@enclavehealth.io
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Compliance-conditioned credits for private VPC POC

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Redwood runtime looks promising for our clinical ingestion and de-identification flows. We want to run a short Private/VPC POC that mirrors our prod networking and audit requirements before committing to Dedicated capacity.

Because this POC will require an isolated environment + additional SOC2 evidence review, our security team asks that any promotional credits or trial top-ups be tied to an attestation of data handling and evidence delivery timelines. Specifically they want:
- A documented list of artifacts Redwood will provide (SOC2 report excerpts, logging/audit retention, KMS integration notes)
- A max window for evidence delivery (we asked for 10 business days)
- Confirmation that trial resources will be isolated to our VPC with no cross-tenant caching

Can Redwood approve a $12k pilot credit that’s conditional on the attestation above? If yes, please send the attestation template and any compliance checklist so my security and procurement teams can sign off.

Sam
Sam Farrell
Sr. Security Program Manager | Enclave Health
attachments: enclave-soc2-summary.pdf, requested-evidence-checklist.xlsx

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com <lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com>
To: Sam Farrell <sam.farrell@enclavehealth.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.example.com
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Compliance-conditioned credits for private VPC POC

Hi Sam — appreciate the clear ask and the SOC2 summary. Quick answers up front:
- We can offer a $12,000 pilot credit for a 30-day Private/VPC POC.
- Credits can be conditioned on a short attestation that we’ll provide (template below).
- Isolation guarantee: we will provision tenant-isolated nodes and disable cross-tenant KV caching for the trial.

I’m looping in Ben Carter (sales lead) to help with the credit approval and to document the attestation in our legal/finance flow. Ben — can you confirm this level of financial sponsorship and whether finance needs an SOW or MOU to accompany the credit?

Also attaching a 1-page pilot-scope doc so we all have the same technical boundaries.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
redwood.example.com
attachments: pilot-scope-enclave-poc.docx

From: ben_carter@redwood.example.com <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com, Sam Farrell <sam.farrell@enclavehealth.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Compliance-conditioned credits for private VPC POC

Thanks — looping Finance/Legal next. Internal note for Lauren: finance typically requires an MOU when credits exceed $10k; legal prefers a short addendum that ties the credit to specific deliverables (artifacts + delivery timeline). If procurement at Enclave can sign an MOU (one page) acknowledging the attestation triggers, we can expedite.

Sam — can your procurement team sign a one-page "Pilot Credits & Evidence MOU"? If yes, we'll draft it and include the attestation language. Also let us know whether you need a DocuSign link or a signed PDF.

Ben Carter
Strategic Sales Lead | Redwood Inference

From: procurement@enclavehealth.io <procurement@enclavehealth.io>
To: ben_carter@redwood.example.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com
Cc: Sam Farrell <sam.farrell@enclavehealth.io>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 08:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Compliance-conditioned credits for private VPC POC

Hi Ben / Lauren — procurement here. We can sign a one-page MOU that ties the $12,000 credit to the delivery of the attestation items listed. A couple of practical requests:
- Can Redwood confirm the artifacts list exactly (SOC2 excerpts, logging TTL, KMS key rotation notes, network isolation diagram)? That helps our security team match items to controls.
- We need the attestation template and the maximum SLA for artifact delivery (Procurement prefers 10 business days but will accept 15 if Redwood cannot meet 10).

If you can send the draft today, we can queue the internal approval and sign electronically.

Thanks,
Procurement Team | Enclave Health

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com <lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com>
To: procurement@enclavehealth.io, Sam Farrell <sam.farrell@enclavehealth.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, aditya_rao@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Compliance-conditioned credits for private VPC POC

Procurement — thanks. Attached below is the attestation language we propose plus the exact artifacts Redwood will deliver. I’ve kept the artifact list narrow to avoid back-and-forth:
1) SOC2 Type II report excerpt (scope: security + confidentiality) – redacted to remove unrelated client data
2) Audit log retention description and sample log schema (retention: 90 days by default for the trial)
3) KMS integration notes including key rotation cadence and customer KMS options
4) Network topology diagram showing isolated VPC and no cross-tenant KV caching

Attestation trigger: Redwood will provide the artifacts within 10 business days of MOU signature. Pilot credits ($12,000) will be applied to the Enclave account within 2 business days of MOU execution. Credits will be forfeited if artifacts are not delivered in the agreed window.

Marissa, Aditya — please confirm you’re comfortable with the 10 business day SLA and the artifact set. If legal/finance want any wording tweaks, flag them here and Ben will coordinate.

Best,
Lauren

artifacts-list.xlsx

From: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>

Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Compliance-conditioned credits for private VPC POC

Lauren / Ben — this looks fine to me. 10 business days is reasonable for the artifact set. A couple of small internal checks:
- Finance: confirm we can route $12k as promotional credits against RDW-8371 without a multi-month commitment. (Ben — please confirm).
- Security: we should explicitly call out that PII should not be stored by Redwood during the trial and that sample logs will be redacted; I suggest adding a single sentence to the attestation template to that effect.

If those two items are OK, give procurement the MOU (DocuSign) and we’ll sign on our side. Ben — if you want, I can approve the credit now so procurement’s signature is the last step.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
